questionText:
A Boolean digital circuit is composed using two 4-input multiplexers (M1 and M2) and one 2-input multiplexer (M3) as shown in the figure. X0–X7 are the inputs of the multiplexers M1 and M2 and could be connected to either 0 or 1. The select lines of the multiplexers are connected to Boolean variables A, B and C as shown.

Which one of the following set of values of (X0, X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7) will realise the Boolean function $\overline{A} + \overline{A}.\overline{C} + A.\overline{B}.C$?
explanation:
Step 1: Write down the expression for the output of each multiplexer.

Multiplexer M1 has select lines $S_1 = A$ and $S_0 = C$. Its output $Q_{M1}$ is:
$Q_{M1} = \overline{A}\overline{C} X_0 + \overline{A}C X_1 + A\overline{C} X_2 + AC X_3$

Multiplexer M2 also has select lines $S_1 = A$ and $S_0 = C$. Its output $Q_{M2}$ is:
$Q_{M2} = \overline{A}\overline{C} X_4 + \overline{A}C X_5 + A\overline{C} X_6 + AC X_7$

Multiplexer M3 has select line $S = B$. Its final output $Q$ is:
$Q = \overline{B} Q_{M1} + B Q_{M2}$

Step 2: Expand the complete function $Q(A, B, C)$.

$Q = \overline{A}\overline{B}\overline{C} X_0 + \overline{A}\overline{B}C X_1 + A\overline{B}\overline{C} X_2 + A\overline{B}C X_3 + \overline{A}B\overline{C} X_4 + \overline{A}BC X_5 + AB\overline{C} X_6 + ABC X_7$

Step 3: Simplify the given Boolean function $F(A, B, C)$.

$F = \overline{A} + \overline{A}.\overline{C} + A.\overline{B}.C = \overline{A} + A.\overline{B}.C$

Writing $F$ in sum-of-minterms form:
• $\overline{A}$ corresponds to minterms $m_0 (000), m_1 (001), m_2 (010), m_3 (011)$.
• $A.\overline{B}.C$ corresponds to minterm $m_5 (101)$.

So, $F = \sum m(0, 1, 2, 3, 5)$.

Step 4: Compare terms to find the values of $X_0$ through $X_7$.

• $m_0 (000) \implies \overline{A}\overline{B}\overline{C} X_0 \implies X_0 = 1$
• $m_1 (001) \implies \overline{A}\overline{B}C X_1 \implies X_1 = 1$
• $m_2 (010) \implies \overline{A}B\overline{C} X_4 \implies X_4 = 1$
• $m_3 (011) \implies \overline{A}BC X_5 \implies X_5 = 1$
• $m_5 (101) \implies A\overline{B}C X_3 \implies X_3 = 1$
• All other inputs $X_2, X_6, X_7 = 0$.

Therefore, $(X_0, X_1, X_2, X_3, X_4, X_5, X_6, X_7) = (1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0)$.
